title: Core section isomorphism unit identity
statement: Let $i:Z\to X$ and $h:X\prime\to X$ be scheme morphisms and $F$ an étale sheaf of sets [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets]. Use the explicitly constructed lift, comparison and preimage-open isomorphism [def-weil-pbc-gabber-h0-zariski-constructions], and put $f=\mathrm{pr}_2:Z\times_X X\prime\to X\prime$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. As functions on $G(X\prime)$, the composite of the étale unit for $f$ at the top-open étale object, restriction along the preimage-open isomorphism, and the canonical section comparison equals the function sending $s$ to the étale descent comparison for $h$ followed by $f$ applied to lift($s$), transported along pullback.condition.symm. There is no arbitrary Zariski comparison beta, no unit-compatibility hypothesis, and no closedness or finiteness hypothesis.

proof.text: Put j = pullback.snd i h, B = base change along j, H = h*F, K = j*H, and a equal to the first etale-object isomorphism in gabberZariskiSectionIso. Both a.inv followed by gabberPreimageEtaleIso j top.hom and B.map (gabberTopPullbackIso h).inv are morphisms over pullback i h into the pullback of the top-open inclusion of Xprime. That inclusion is an isomorphism, so its base-change second projection is an isomorphism and in particular a monomorphism. Forget to schemes, cancel this projection, and use the defining over-morphism equations to prove the maps equal. Apply K.obj.map to their opposites and evaluate on the unit section; contravariant functoriality gives the composite of the two restrictions.

Apply clause (0), site-object naturality, of etaleSetInverseImageCompositionUnits to (gabberTopPullbackIso h).inv and the section s. Its equality and the first step identify the two inner section expressions. Group the remaining three factors into an isomorphism e: the same chosen sheaf composition component, restriction along pullbackComp, and transport along pullback.condition.symm. Expand the section comparison on the left by focused conversion, rewrite the inner expression by unit naturality, and expand e. Expand etaleSetDescentComparison and gabberZariskiLift on the right. Evaluation of composed Type-valued isomorphisms and of the sheafToPresheaf image identifies the factors. Congruence and simplification of sheafToPresheaf object projections and functor composition close the remaining definitional equalities. Function extensionality proves the stated equation, without closedness or finiteness assumptions and also for empty schemes.

lean.statement:
theorem gabber_h0_zariski_section_unit_equation
    {X Z X' : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X) (h : X' ⟶ X)
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1))) :
    gabberZariskiCompare i h F ∘
      (((Scheme.etaleSetPullback (pullback.snd i h)).obj
        ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback h).obj F)).obj.map
          (gabberPreimageEtaleIso (pullback.snd i h) ⊤).hom.op) ∘
      (etaleSetDescentUnit (pullback.snd i h)
        ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback h).obj F) (Scheme.Etale.mk (⊤ : X'.Opens).ι)) =
      fun s : (gabberZariskiG h F).obj.obj (op (⊤ : X'.Opens)) ↦
        eqToHom (congrArg
          (fun k : pullback i h ⟶ X ↦ ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback k).obj F).obj.obj
            (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ k).obj
              (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X))))) (pullback.condition (f := i) (g := h)).symm)
          (etaleSetDescentComparison h (pullback.snd i h) F
            (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X)) (gabberZariskiLift h F s))
